maps.description: Starts with the intro cinematic. Includes P1 Chamber 00, 05, mono-portalgun pickup, P1 Chamber 08, 12 and dual-portalgun pickup
Includes a broken P1 Chamber 13, another broken chamber, BTS exploration and the GLaDOS chamber with the reactivation sequence
Alternate/older version of the GLaDOS chamber and reactivation sequence. Course door doesn't open.

Slowfield course. Features various slowfield puzzles, portalgun slowfield upgrade and retrieving the course's personality sphere, the Aquarium Core. Includes the fling section from P1 Chamber 18 and a broken version of the P1 map with the ceiling crusher.
Various Pneumatic Diversity Vent puzzles including turrets and hover turrets. Rat!??
Unfinished hover turret course? Puzzles involve hover turrets and faith plates. Features retrieving the course's personality sphere, the Curiosity Core

Lightbridge course? Includes early versions of Shoot through Wall, Turret Blocker, Column Blocker, Climb for Line of Sight, Bridge the Gap and Pull the Rug. Features retrieving the course's personality sphere, the Curiosity Core
